Overview

Copiapó is a city in AT with a population of 175,000. A mining city in the Atacama region, famous for the 2010 mining rescue and its desert landscapes. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year.
